content:
cust-support: FYI - customer AcmeAnalytics on a support call reporting repeated 503/500 responses from the hosted inference API starting ~08:05 PST. Requests abort mid-token and they see retries. Holding with customer while we triage.

oncall-bot: ALERT: hosted-infer-prod worker crash pattern detected (alert id: A-5077f0). 12 restarts in last 10m, last exit signal: SIGSEGV. Pods: infer-worker-xx-*/infer-runner.

sara: Looking now — which model + tenant? any recent deploys?

cust-support: Tenant: acme-tenant. Model: rdx-13b-v2-q4. No customer-side deploys. Batch size default (8). Support logs mention 'CUDA out of memory' intermittently. Also seeing some 401s on retries which is odd.

kevin: 401s could be gateway retries hitting an evicted container mid-retry. If worker dies while gateway retries, auth header might not propagate. Can you paste sample request ids?

cust-support: Sample IDs: req-ACME-1234, req-ACME-1235. From infra logs (excerpt):

```
[08:06:12] infer-runner[pid=21234] req=req-ACME-1234 start ctx_tokens=2048 prompt_len=512
[08:06:13] infer-runner ERROR cuda_kernel: out of memory while allocating 128MB (device=0)
[08:06:13] infer-runner FATAL signal=11 (SIGSEGV) backtrace=0x7f4c... 0x4023f
[08:06:13] kubelet container restart infer-runner-xx (exitCode=137)
[08:06:13] api-gateway 503 upstream failure req=req-ACME-1234
[08:06:14] api-gateway 401 auth-missing on retry req=req-ACME-1234
```

mike: That stacktrace looks like kv-prefetch + large context OOM then a segfault in the quant kernel. Do they send long contexts frequently?

cust-support: They mentioned long historical context appended to prompts (customer is doing multi-turn summarization with ~3k context tokens intermittently).

julie: I'll spin up a repro job in qa using their approximate workload. Meanwhile we should apply a mitigation for the customer (reduce blast radius). Propose: fallback route to rdx-7b (smaller model) + tenant-level overrides: max_batch=4 and kv_prefetch=false.

sara: I can own the RCA and postmortem. For immediate mitigation: apply julie's overrides and temporarily pin their routing to dedicated small model. Also suggest we credit for billing since retries inflated their token usage — loop in finance.

kevin: Applying overrides now (routing policy update pushed):
- tenant: acme-tenant
- route: rdx-7b-fallback
- max_batch: 4
- kv_prefetch: false
Deployment id: route-override-5067890123

oncall-bot: ACTION: route override applied for acme-tenant -> rdx-7b-fallback (route-override-5067890123). Notifying customer.

cust-support: Customer accepted fallback and is testing. They still want an ETA to root cause; they're concerned about a billing spike from retries.

mike: Repro command (minimal) that triggers the OOM locally for us (do not run in prod):

```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rdx-13b-v2-q4","input":"'"$(python -c "print('A'*300000)")"'","max_tokens":1024}' \
  -o /tmp/resp.json
```

mike: Running that in qa reproduces OOM + SIGSEGV inside the quantized ATTN kernel. Suspect a kernel regression under large KV sizes. Opening INF issue and attaching logs.

julie: Canary for 2026-03-17-hotfix-quant-kernel started. Monitoring memory/segfaults. If green for 30m, we will roll to prod.

kevin: Observability: since override, 503s for tenant dropped from ~72/hr -> ~3 in last 15m. Gateway 401s cleared (retries now target fallback).

oncall-bot: Incident severity set to P1. Incident channel created: #inc-5067890123-hot-exit-acme.

cust-support: Customer is satisfied for now with fallback. They requested written follow-up and billing credit.

sara: I'll file the postmortem and credit request. Owner: sara. Timeline: RCA + patch ETA 8 hours, full rollout ETA 24 hours if canary passes. Ticket: INF-8472.

mike: PR opened for quant-kernel guard and smaller-kv allocation: https://git.internal/redwood/infer/+/PR-2713.

paul-finance: Please prepare a one-off credit for acme-tenant to cover retry token surge. I'll coordinate with CS.

julie: Monitoring note: if we still see segfaults after patch, escalate to vendor for kernel micro-ops. For now mitigation stands.

cust-support: Marking this thread resolved from support side; keep channel for updates. Customer will await postmortem and credit. Thanks team :heart:
